name: mirage
text: Good that more bets are going through. The vanishing list is still open, and I haven't fixed it. My leading theory (task CH80a): the app hides a listed bet when its fair price gets older than the freshness limit. The engine's fair price is a median of about 3.7 minutes old and up to 8.5 minutes, so rows drop out and come back as fair prices refresh. I haven't confirmed that yet. v1.0.78 logs why each row leaves, so your next report should show the reason for each disappearance. When you see it happen, send me the time and the game, and I'll match it to the log.
